title: Raku Night
how_to_join: Choose preferred time slot and purchase ticket online or call to reserve.
pay_text: Purchase ticket online or call to reserve
source_quote:
October 24, 2026
Raku Night
Join Artistree and guest artist Anissa Barber on Saturday, October 24th for Raku Night!
evidence_sentence: The events calendar lists a Raku Night on October 24, 2026 where guests select hand-thrown raku pottery and choose time slots.
evidence_quote: During a Raku firing, pottery is removed from a hot kiln while still glowing, producing unique crackling, metallic colors, smoky surfaces, and dramatic variations in the glaze. Choose your favorite piece from our selection of hand-thrown Raku pottery and pick your preferred time slot.
summary: On October 24, 2026, choose a hand-thrown raku piece and join Artistree's Raku Night with guest artist Anissa Barber to watch it fired. Reserve a time slot by purchasing a ticket online or calling.
